events.title: Spain holds a snap general election for the Congress of Deputies and the Senate.
Swiss voters decide whether to amend the law governing exports of military equipment.
Swiss voters decide whether to raise VAT to fund a 13th monthly state pension payment.
Swiss voters decide on a federal initiative to change how married couples are taxed.
Swiss voters decide on a federal initiative to restrict the sale and use of noisy fireworks by private individuals.
Spain holds snap parliamentary elections for all 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies and 209 seats in the Senate
OPEC+ ministers meet to review crude oil market conditions and decide on early 2027 production quotas

Swiss voters decide in a federal popular vote on four national proposals, including a 0.4% VAT hike to fund the 13th OASI pension payment, amendments to the War Material Act, married couples' taxation, and fireworks restrictions

EU Euro 7 vehicle emissions, brake particle, and battery durability standards take effect for the type-approval of new passenger car and light van models (categories M1 and N1) across the European Union and the Czech Republic
Ecuador holds nationwide local and provincial elections, moved forward from February 2027 due to El Niño forecasts
Armenia holds local council and municipal head elections across 12 communities in 7 provinces, including Kapan, Ashtarak, and Metsamor
Czech MPs Denis Doksanský and Jiří Kotlík attend the opening day of the Inter-Parliamentary Conference on Peace and Stability in Dublin
CAS Space conducts its first sea launch of a Kinetica-1 solid-fuel rocket carrying three satellites from the South China Sea off Guangdong
EU transitional period expires for mandatory electronic Certificates of Conformity (eCoC) for vehicle manufacturers across Member States
Greek secondary school teachers' union (OLME) issues formal strike declaration for daily three-hour work stoppages throughout December against the teacher evaluation law
ICAN opens Nuclear Ban Week and the Nuclear Ban Forum 2026 at Riverside Church in New York ahead of the UN Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons review
United Nations Committee Against Torture (CAT) continues its 85th session at the Palais des Nations in Geneva
International Monetary Fund (IMF) begins its regional executive training on fiscal policy and strategic tax management in Kuwait City
Mediterranean Children's Movement concludes the 2026 regional Peace Conference 'Connected by Sea for Peace' in Valletta, Malta
Claim filing deadline expires for the $30 million tranche of the Equifax class-action settlement over hard credit inquiry disputes in the United States
Application deadline closes for the selection procedure for Director of the Communications and Publicity Department at the Czech Ministry of Regional Development (MMR)
České dráhy concludes a week-long single-track rail closure and maintenance operation on main corridor line 271 between Polom and Suchdol nad Odrou
Prague Public Transit Company (DPP) begins regular scheduled passenger operations of its illuminated Christmas tram and bus fleet across the capital for the फर्स्ट Advent Sunday

Regional and municipal capitals across the Czech Republic—including Hradec Králové, Pardubice, Jihlava, Plzeň, and Ostrava-Poruba—open their main Christmas markets and light municipal trees amid city-centre traffic closures
National Theatre Brno (NdB) stages its Edison-themed Christmas tree lighting ceremony outside the Mahen Theatre, followed by a sold-out holiday concert by Adam Plachetka and Melody Makers
Prague Zoo launches its Advent programme with a parade and tree lighting ceremony, while Dvořák Hall at the Rudolfinum hosts the 'Šťastný Advent' classical opening concert
Spain holds a snap general election for Congress and the Senate
OPEC and non-OPEC ministers hold the 42nd ministerial meeting on 2027 production policy
Switzerland votes on an AHV VAT rise, a fireworks ban, married-couple tax and the war-material law
Ecuador holds sectional elections and the vote for the CPCCS
Seven OPEC+ countries meet to review market conditions and output
Euro 7 starts applying to new types of cars and light vans in the EU
Gagauzia holds a runoff for bashkan and second-round votes for the People's Assembly
NASA targets the Northrop Grumman Cygnus NG-25 cargo launch to the space station
Czech regulated maximum petrol and diesel prices remain in force nationwide
Azores airport ground-handling strike runs until the end of Sunday
Open-ended Spanish airport strikes continue, including at Barajas and El Prat
Advance polls open for six Canadian federal by-elections
Catalonia's indefinite doctors' strike continues
Czech MPs Doksanský and Kotlík attend an interparliamentary conference on peace and stability in Dublin
Night train Slovakia from Prague runs earlier between Prague and Bohumín because of track works
